faqs.q: Who is eligible for Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD?
faqs.a: Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD is designed for eligible Indian Army personnel. Applicants should check the latest eligibility requirements with Bank of Baroda before applying.

faqs.q: How many reward points can I earn on departmental store spends?
faqs.a: Cardholders can earn 10 reward points per Rs. 100 spent at departmental stores. The accelerated reward earning is capped at 1,000 reward points per month.

faqs.q: What is the value of reward points on Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD?
faqs.a: Reward points can be redeemed against cashback at a value of 1 reward point = Rs. 0.25.

faqs.q: Does Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD offer airport lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers 8 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per year, with 2 visits per quarter, on spending Rs. 20,000 in the preceding quarter.

faqs.q: What are the welcome benefits offered on the card?
faqs.a: Cardholders can earn 500 bonus reward points on spending Rs. 5,000 or more within 60 days of card issuance. The card also offers a complimentary 12-month Amazon Prime Membership on spending Rs. 1 Lakh within 90 days of issuance and a complimentary 12-month FITPASS PRO Membership.

faqs.q: Does the card offer add-on cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Cardholders can get up to 3 lifetime free add-on credit cards for eligible family members, subject to the applicable terms and conditions.

faqs.q: What concierge services are available with Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD?
faqs.a: The card offers 24x7 concierge services for domestic and international requirements through the RuPay variant. The availability of specific services may be subject to the applicable terms and conditions.

faqs.q: Is Indian Army YODDHA BOBCARD suitable for UPI payments?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers 2 reward points per Rs. 100 on eligible spends across other categories, including UPI transactions. As a RuPay card, it can be linked to supported UPI apps for eligible payments.
